Alex — thanks, good questions. Short answers below and I’ve attached the slide deck again.

- SOC 2: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II. We don’t publish the full report publicly but can share a redacted copy under an NDA or provide a secure vendor portal link. We’ll also share a one-page security summary.
- Data residency: yes, you can pin inference and logs to specific AWS regions; we commonly do us-west-2 for Pacific customers.
- SSO: we support SAML/OIDC and have an Okta connector; provisioning and SCIM are available on enterprise plans.
